outline:
本課程幫助學生習得敘述、描寫、推論、議論、省思、說明等文體方面的寫作技巧，並指導學生從閱讀、圖片、日常生活事件，及課堂討論內容中取材，以加強邏輯思考和流暢寫作能力。
This course aims to develop and reinforce students’ strengths to create unified and coherent pieces of composition in a variety of styles--narrative, descriptive, argumentative, reflective, and expository. Students will be guided to write in response to readings, pictures, events in their daily lives, and discussions from the class. Thought-provoking topics dealing with current issues are used to stimulate and foster critical writing strategies. This course enables students to write and discuss logically and clearly; they also need to incorporate grammatically newly-built vocabulary into their writing.

assessment:
Writing Portfolio: 40%
Creative Piece: 15%
Academic Essay (draft + revision + reflection): 35%
Participation (including Peer Feedback): 10%

By the end of the course, students will be able to:
- Develop a piece of creative writing from a focused freewrite, memory, or observation (15%).
- Write an academic essay that makes one clear claim about a text, supports that claim with evidence, and places at least two writers in conversation (35%).
- Revise the academic essay formal draft substantially by improving language, organization, or development in response to feedback, and include a short reflective note explaining the writing process and key revision decisions (part of the academic essay).
- Provide descriptive peer feedback that explains their experience as a reader, identifying specific moments where writing is engaging, confusing, or raises questions (part of the participation grade).
- Document their writing process in a portfolio of in-class writing, drafts, feedback, and reflections that show effort and growth over the semester (40%). The portfolio will be evaluated on effort, engagement with writing prompts, and improvement over time.
